Thank you for the positive review of Modern House Numbers! We truly appreciate your recommendation and always value customer feedback. For the best installation results, we recommend using a clear, quick-drying, multipurpose, exterior-grade epoxy. If a slower-curing epoxy is used, additional holding time will be needed to ensure a secure bond.

We’ve created a helpful video guide with detailed tips—here’s a link to our YouTube channel: https://youtu.be/tWLCQoO6RPo?si=-zr0jfyw991XZXnk "Choosing the Right Adhesive for Your Modern House Numbers Installation".
